text:
maya: Quick UX review request — dropped a new mock and screenshots in the Figma link. Working on the 'Prompt Suite diff' modal + a slightly changed scorecard approval flow. TL;DR: we need copy polish, accessibility pass, and a decision on default state for diffs (collapsed vs expanded). figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/prompt-suites eric: Thanks — this looks great. My product ask: failing diffs should be visible by default so reviewers don't miss regressions. Happy for non-failing diffs to be collapsed. Also can we make the approve action one-click but with a tiny confirm toast? :thinking: maya: @eric yeah that was my thought too. One-click approve but show a small undo snackbar for 8s. Also thinking about labeling: 'Approve suite' vs 'Sign off' — leaning toward 'Approve suite' to match existing eval wording. Thoughts? olivia: From evals side — callout that we should surface sample size and baseline metric in the diff header. When a change is small but significant it's easy to miss. Example: "Δ BLEU: -0.3 (n=500)" — makes it actionable. :eyes: sam: Accessibility quick notes: keyboard focus must go into the modal and trap. The diff toggle needs aria-expanded and the expand/collapse target should be in the DOM order. Minimal snippet to show intent: ```html
...diff content...
``` sam: also ensure the row selection checkboxes have accessible labels, e.g. `aria-label="Select prompt 42: paraphrase test"`. Screen readers will otherwise just read "checkbox". maya: Good call. I'll update the mock to include those attributes in the dev spec. design-bot: Automated design checklist — contrast OK for primary CTAs (AA), focus visible on interactive controls, 44x44 tap targets, modal close button has accessible name. Missing: keyboard-only walkthrough screenshots, heading hierarchy check. eric: Copy nit from the scorecard approval work: current helper text reads "Approving will lock this suite" — can we change to "Approving finalizes this suite for production use"? Slightly clearer for PMs and legal. maya: I like that. Replace helper text and add microcopy under the undo snackbar: "Undo will reopen the review for edits." qa-bot: Please add stable test ids for e2e: `data-test="prompt-suite-row-"` and `data-test="approve-suite-btn"`. We had flakiness when the DOM structure changed. sam: noted — we'll add data-test attributes and a small Cypress test for keyboard nav. Also will ensure focus trap implementation passes axe checks. olivia: One more UX ask — in the regression diff list, can we add a tiny sparkline for recent trend (last 7 runs)? Helps detect whether this is a one-off blip. If space is tight, make it hover-to-expand. maya: Nice. I'll try a compact sparkline inline and a hover popup with full chart. eric: Plan for rollout? Can we ship behind a feature flag and enable for 10% of org users first? Then topple to 100% after a week if no regressions in metrics. maya: Yes feature flag + canary rollout. I'll add the PR template with the flag key and a checklist for QA + A11Y. Assigning follow-ups: @sam add aria + test ids, @olivia add metric labels to diff, @eric approve final copy, @maya update figma and handoff. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark: sam: On it. Will post a small PR link when ready. maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/542 — includes markup and demo video. Please review. eric: Reviewed quickly — a couple tiny copy tweaks in the toast but otherwise LGTM. qa-bot: Added e2e checklist to the PR and kicked off nightly job. maya: Closing thread for now — will re-open if accessibility scan finds anything. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
